newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul prices up, volume jumps on abritrage.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul prices up, volume jumps on abritrage.

text.p: Traded volume on Istanbul's gold exchange leaped to 1,025 kilos on Friday from Thursday's 230 kilos as banks engaged in arbitrage trade, dealers said.
The gold price firmed to $353.00 an ounce and 1,437,000 lira per gram versus $350.00 and 1,427,700 lira on Thursday following higher levels on European markets.

"After the opening, gold remained steady at $353 throughout the day, so banks took advantage of currency movements to conduct arbitrage. There is really not much physical demand on the market yet," one dealer said.
The lira fell sharply to 126,100 against the dollar from 125,260 at Thursday's close.
Of the day's volume, 590 kilos was recorded in the morning session and 435 kilos in the afternoon, with 61 percent of the total trade done in lira terms.
